rationale: The plan matches the reference on every axis: raw Salmon counts into DESeq2 Wald (with edgeR QL as a check), design ~condition with an explicit control reference and treated-over-control contrast, a minimal and justified >=10-in->=3 filter, size factors/TMM inside the model with an explicit ban on pre-scaling, BH at 0.05 set in results() with apeglm shrinkage and no post-hoc fold-change filter. A blind-VST PCA, distance heatmap and library-size check precede the test with a stated flag-don't-remove policy, and the power limitation of 3v3 is stated up front without loosening alpha. Enrichment is correctly and explicitly omitted, and the report specifies methods, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, sessionInfo and caveats. The only minor reservations are the framing of the DESeq2/edgeR intersection as the headline high-confidence set, which further reduces already low power and is not standard, and a QC policy that stops at flagging without saying how a confirmed mislabeled sample would be handled.
